column1: # Re-appliable local customizations for third-party agent skills.
# Columns (tab-separated, '#' starts a comment, blank lines ignored):
#   skill            identifier, also the CLI filter argument
#   target           path of the installed file, relative to the repository root
#   upstream_url     where upstream publishes the file (used by tools/refresh.sh)
#   upstream_sha256  sha256 of the file as shipped upstream; patches/<skill>.patch applies to it
#   patched_sha256   sha256 of the file after the override is applied (idempotency check)
#   patch            patch applied when upstream_sha256 matches; upstream edits still flow
#   full             whole customized file, copied when upstream_sha256 is unknown
# Maintained with tools/refresh.sh and tools/validate.sh. Never edit hashes by hand.
